name: Spawn of Ulban
tactics: A spawn of Ulban assures itself a place of security while it undermines those around it. Foes must fight their way through traps and lackeys before they can confront one of these creatures. Even then, the spawn is a nimble combatant. For these reasons, a spawn of Ulban makes an excellent villain or villain’s sidekick.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

immunities: dominate (any enemy that hits with a power that would dominate the spawn is instead dominated by it [save ends])
description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: cold and fire damage, and the target is dazed until the end of its next turn.
psychic damage, and the target makes a melee or a ranged basic attack as a free action against a creature of the spawn’s choice.
psychic damage, and the target is dominated (save ends).

effect.description: Choose one creature the spawn of Ulban can see. The spawn forms an eldritch bond with that creature until the end of the encounter or until the spawn uses this power again. Whenever the target of this power shifts, the spawn can shift an equal number of squares as a free action.

powers.name: Psionic Boost
powers.usageDetails: when the spawn takes psychic damage
powers.trigger: The spawn hits with bluefire strike or touch of strife.

effect.description: The attack deals 3d10 extra psychic damage.
